Anatomical correctness of hands gripping objects

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text in the speech bubbles. AI generators often produce pseudo-text that looks like letters but isn't readable. Verify if 'SKULL' and 'JUDD' are actual words or gibberish. Also, inspect the central figure's hands; do they have distinct fingers, or do they melt into the staff? Check if the image looks like a photograph of a physical comic book (with paper texture, lighting reflections) or a direct digital generation of a comic-style image (which would fail the 'physical object' aspect of the class definition).
